payloads.lesson: [2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] The repaired version passed the recorded future-audio feature test for 23 scalars and the mel bank, with five beat-grid channels still explicitly oracle; this is not whole-pipeline causality qualification or proof about an earlier checkout. On the same checkpoint and features, corpus-rate threshold calibration lowered Light-BAS minus the shift null from +0.0212 uncalibrated to +0.0179 calibrated, so G-bas-up failed despite the passed rate gate and improved FID/diversity relative to the uncalibrated arm. The nearly unchanged rendered event count shows that this threshold adjustment did not solve surplus flashing, without identifying a unique cause or establishing human LIGHT quality.

[2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] On identical checkpoint outputs, fitted per-channel zero-phase smoothing reduced the LIGHT event-rate ratio relative to real-motion-mapped light from 2.84 unfiltered to 1.19 and lowered FID versus the unfiltered arm, with the rate, FID and across-clip diversity gates recorded as passed. The named 12 Hz arm still had a rate ratio of 2.12 against the required maximum 1.3 and worst high-frequency energy of 72.3 times the corpus against the maximum 2; the fitted arm also failed G-smooth-hf at 5.0 times the corpus. Across-seed diversity fell with fitted smoothing and eight channels reached the smoothing cap, so these gains neither confirm the named filter nor establish a unique flashing mechanism or human LIGHT quality.

[2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] For the audio-only RPMC heads, the offline horizon-zero margin over rhythm was a larger point estimate than the same-split causal margin (+0.1584 versus +0.0964), not a demonstrated significant advantage or a paired comparison with the older different-split ridge margin of +0.3145. At four seconds, the offline margin over rhythm was -0.0206 with CI [-0.1592, 0.1378], failing G-antic-4s despite the recorded shift-control pass. Offline target-derived-hazard arms were invalid because they exposed future target information and remain excluded; the valid audio-only result does not establish anticipation in this recipe or rule out anticipation generally.

[2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] The frozen gain-normalised ridge recipe missed G8.2-r2 on the historical song split: its best two-second channel R2 was +0.0045 versus the zero null and the required +0.20. The loudest-third versus quietest-third section QoM ratio of 1.57, CI [1.52, 1.63], versus equality at 1 supports that measured movement contrast, not the registered chorus/verse endpoint or LIGHT quality. Genre/Effort partialling and independently labelled chorus/verse response remain unmeasured, and inter-coach agreement does not establish audio learnability or a corpus-wide capability ceiling.

[2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] In the recorded Just Dance conditioning recipe, Light-BAS minus the shift null was +0.1065 with real structure versus +0.1347 without structure (paired difference -0.0282, CI [-0.0417, -0.017]) and +0.1197 with shuffled structure, so G-struct-lift and G-struct-shuffle failed. Improved FID relative to no structure remains a valid partial result but does not rescue the primary failure. G-struct-contrast remains unmeasured at the light level, with independent semantic-label and rendered-intensity qualifications incomplete; the refutation is conditional on this frozen recipe, not a general rejection of section control or recurrence memory.

[2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] On the historical 38-song evaluation split, the audio-plus-reference-event-history head achieved event AP/base-rate lift 3.171 versus rhythm 1.481 and same-feature ridge 1.897, with margin over rhythm +1.6902, CI [1.1858, 2.2711], and the recorded aligned shift peak. G8.4-hue remains unmeasured: the palette test was not implemented, and the legacy hue-KL/per-song-mean contract is still undefined rather than supplied by a later palette study. This supports the measured event proxy with reference history, not generated-own-cue deployment, palette prediction or human LIGHT acceptance.

[2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] For the audited Beat Saber conversion and ridge recipe, causal event AP was 0.170 versus shifted-target null 0.131 and beat-trigger scene novelty 0.150, missing both frozen margin gates (+0.039 versus required +0.15; +0.020 versus required +0.05); the reported offline arm still missed the shift margin. The hazard-conditioned neural head improved over its rhythm baseline, but the audio-only head did not show a positive margin, so that partial result does not replace the failed preregistered corpus-eligibility comparisons. xLights was not audited because access was blocked, and the tested Beat Saber component's Stage 9 loss exclusion neither refutes xLights or all authored-light corpora nor establishes human or physical LIGHT qualification.

[2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] On the JD visual-event ridge task, full stems added +0.0185 AP, CI [0.0150, 0.0219], over the mix bus AP of 0.1753 but missed the required +0.02; the neural stem arm's lift 2.99 versus the bus-only checkpoint's 3.17 and rhythm baseline's 1.48 also did not improve on what it replaced. G9.7-split failed: valid head/hand results did not establish the source-specific benefit, while the degenerate footfall R2 and its derived split aggregate are invalid submetrics, not physiological evidence. The recorded 90-song trailing-window/whole-track comparison completes the reporting component of G9.7-causal, not full live LIGHT qualification, and this scoped outcome is not a rejection of every stem method or corpus.

[2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] In the frozen MERT JD-only ridge comparison, the song-mean-residualised gain of +0.0180 AP over the bus (bus AP 0.1751), versus approximately zero gain for the same-width random projection, missed G9.7-emb's required +0.02 despite the raw embedding's +0.0192 gain over the bus. Retaining gain after mean subtraction only excludes complete dependence on the removed song mean: raw song-ID accuracy of 83.4% versus bus 3.6% and chance 0.30% is not a residual-identity test, so the recorded G9.7-leak pass is not clearance of every catalogue-leakage mechanism. Oslo crowd-speed and causal L=0 embedding components remain unmeasured; this recipe-specific magnitude failure neither rules out foundation embeddings generally nor qualifies a live LIGHT path.

[2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation; no new experiment] The completed causal decoder sweep reported own-cue lift 2.41 versus audio-only 2.41 on JD and 1.31 versus 1.33 on RPMC, but per-song decoder confidence intervals were not stored, leaving G10.2-self failed and its uncertainty requirement unqualified while G10.2-size is complete. In the separate JD operator-head test, own-cue lift 1.83 was below audio-only 2.32 (paired difference -0.49, CI [-0.94, -0.15]) and reference-history 3.17, showing that the privileged-history advantage did not carry over under this tested recursion. The operator-head interval cannot fill the decoder endpoint, absent decoder intervals do not establish equivalence, and these results do not reject all history methods or establish human LIGHT acceptance.

2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation, not a new experiment: The registered fixed-role optical calibration passed the three-scene ramp controls, with whole-rig dimmer response 3.68561 versus 1.06714 for the recorded pre-role comparator at the frozen comparison settings. This supports only the fixed-rig/camera simulator calibration, not learned music conditioning, full-track LIGHT quality, human acceptance, physical photometry or default promotion; the separate native-music failure is unchanged.

2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation, not a new experiment: On saved Shpongle, timing_revision_01 reduced requested-motion-to-emitted-DMX lag to 0.225 s versus surface_revision_02 at 0.450 s, but missed the 0.20 s gate. Its descriptive 1-2 Hz emitted/raw amplitude ratio was 0.301 versus 0.243 for that baseline and still missed 0.35; the sampled visual gate also failed despite mechanics, quiet, photometry and spatial passes. Completed sampled review is not continuous human audiovisual acceptance, and this offline controller result does not qualify audio synchronization, music generation, hardware or the LIGHT product.

2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation, not a new experiment: On the same saved Shpongle requests, timing_revision_02 achieved a pooled signed requested-to-emitted lag estimate of 0 s versus surface_revision_02 at 0.450 s, passing timing under the original software mechanics. The descriptive 1-2 Hz emitted/raw amplitude ratio fell to 0.221 versus 0.243 for that baseline and missed 0.35, while the sampled visual gate failed despite quiet, photometry and spatial passes. This completed offline fitting study does not measure audio-to-light synchronization or establish human music-fit, hardware capability or product qualification.

2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation, not a new experiment: With saved Shpongle targets and the same convex objective, actuator_budget_01 raised the 1-2 Hz emitted/raw amplitude ratio to 0.790 versus timing_revision_02 at 0.221 by changing the declared simulator caps to 90 deg/s and 360 deg/s2 from 30 deg/s and 80 deg/s2. Numerical gates pass only for the new simulation profile, while old-cap exceedances and the failed sampled visual gate remain. This counterfactual does not establish physical fixture safety, human music-fit, learned conditioning or a qualified LIGHT product, and does not authorize cap escalation or default promotion.

2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation, not a new experiment: On the fixed saved body and unchanged faster simulator profile, stage_geometry_01 increased the 194-201 s median first-hit span to 10.610 m versus actuator_budget_01 at 3.770 m. The active wall fraction 0.00958 still missed the 0.10 requirement and the sampled visual gate failed despite the other geometry, dynamics, validity, quiet, mechanics and photometry passes. This bounded geometry improvement is not human music-fit, hardware or product qualification, and later stage02 anchor results do not retroactively pass this revision.

2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation, not a new experiment: On the same saved Shpongle body and simulator profile, stage_geometry_02 static anchors increased active geometric wall first-hit fraction to 0.487917 versus stage_geometry_01 at 0.009583, passing the registered numeric gates and sampled visual-coverage procedure. Stage02 redistributes already-separated targets; it does not own stage01's contraction rescue or establish improved decoded coverage from geometric wall use alone. The fan/row persists, while human audiovisual, music-fit, aesthetic, physical-fixture and LIGHT-product acceptance are not established by this result; no default promotion follows.

2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation, not a new experiment: In the matched seed0 study, the physical objective reduced generated sliding excess to 0.343127 m/s versus masked_native at 0.881744 m/s, but still failed the absolute 0.20 m/s gate. Correct-versus-donor/shift conditioning failed on the frozen summary-energy-score instrument, and visual qualification failed, with matched incumbent 3D lighting unavailable despite completed scheduled renders and sampled reviews. Other physical, consistency and coverage passes do not establish learned music-driven LIGHT quality or human music-fit acceptance, reverse the blocked qualification/seed1 decision, or refute physical objectives generally.

2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation, not a new experiment: On fixed Shpongle and the legacy camera, stage03 gain2 produced geometric torso 1-2 Hz RMS of 0.480092 px versus stage02 gain0 at 0.432625 px, missing both the 2x and 1 px requirements. Other numeric gates and the sampled visual-coverage procedure passed, but synthetic sign restoration and projected geometry do not establish decoded pixel tracking, a new large composition or human music-fit acceptance. Retain the parent caption correction and limit this failure to the tested gain, track, band and camera, without a global signed-lean rule-out or product/default promotion.

2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation, not a new experiment: With fixed stage02 emitted movement, the combined closer-camera/zero-zoom/angular-flux recipe increased the geometric 1-2 Hz motion/radius proxy to 0.336552 versus legacy-camera/native-zoom/legacy-edge at 0.140474. Completed factorial controls, the global mean display-brightness procedure with reported rounding residual, and sampled reviews support fixed-scene observability, not decoded optical flow, calibrated lumens or universal absence of clipping. The music PASS gate is explicitly a held-source/no-music-claim control, not human acceptance; the persistent fan remains and no learned conditioning, hardware, LIGHT-product qualification or default promotion follows.

2026-09-28 retrospective interpretation, not a new experiment: On fixed saved bodies, pose_stage_01 raised the NEW exact-edge 0.5-4 Hz geometric mean-per-head motion/radius ratio to 1.456716 versus same-body stage02 at 0.635937 in the Shpongle 70-90 s interval, with registered numeric/control gates and the selected reference comparisons passing. Sampled media coverage and the global brightness procedure completed with a reported rounding residual, but the projection nullspace, fan and tangles remain; this instrument is not interchangeable with the earlier 1-2 Hz optics measure or proof of literal body readability or universal gesture preservation. No human audiovisual acceptance, learned music conditioning, hardware or LIGHT-product/default qualification follows, and the earlier generator conditioning and absolute-sliding failures remain unchanged.
